name: Heartomics: Valkyries
source:
Ateon. Gaia created this land so that she could live with her children. As time passed, an unknown evil blemished it all. Thus, Gaia disavowed the disobedient humans and abandoned the world she created. From that day on, she was referred to as “Terra”.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/603210/Heartomics_Valkyries/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阿顿。盖亚创造了这片土地，以便她能够与她的孩子们一起生活。随着时间的流逝，一种未知的邪恶玷污了这一切。因此，盖亚拒绝了不服从的人类，并放弃了她创造的世界。从那天起，她就被称为“Terra”。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/603210/Heartomics_Valkyries/]Steam[/url]]
